description: Client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft that exports any region of your world to OBJ and glTF (.glb), textures included.

mods.name: Meshify Region Exporter
mods.description: Select a region with /meshify start and /meshify end, then export it to OBJ + MTL + textures with /meshify export. Supports modded blocks via baked models, mob heads, chests and fluids. Based on the pos2obj mod on CurseForge by usagi_san.
